actual_generation.wall_scope: Per-item parent wall duration includes subprocess startup and validation/hash overhead; not a universal runtime forecast.

tests.scope: 34bounded producer/cache/network/consumer-coordinate and shared-autodiff-zero tests; not production-success or rendered evidence.

limits: No training/model/solver/kernel rerun, new parameter/network request, render or audio.
Direct cached-array algebra validates listed invariants only; stored producer difference metrics also rely on exact frozen producer/assertion code and successful original logs.
NaN spacing markers outside representable formats and insufficient-window slope fits are not silently classified as corrupt numerical results.
packaged_npz: Not copied; originalNPZcontent hashes/sizes/mtime and array shapes/dtypes preserved in production and validation receipts. No raw corpus/modelweights bundled.
driver_source_scope: Driver file copied at review; root attests executed path, but driver bytes are not independently bound by the original progress receipt. Producer/helper/sharedAD bytes are bound by exact root freeze and per-item recipe.
